1.zh: 扫罗死后，大卫击杀亚玛力人回来，在洗革拉住了两天。
1.en: After the death of Saul, David returned from defeating the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.

1.zh: 第三天，有一人从扫罗的营里出来，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘，到大卫面前伏地叩拜。
1.en: On the third day a man arrived from Saul's camp, with his clothes torn and with dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.

1.zh: 大卫问他说：你从哪里来？他说：我从以色列的营里逃来。
1.en: "Where have you come from?" David asked him. He answered, "I have escaped from the Israelite camp."

1.zh: 大卫又问他说：事情怎样？请你告诉我。他回答说：百姓从阵上逃跑，也有许多人仆倒死亡；扫罗和他儿子约拿单也死了。
1.en: "What happened?" David asked. "Tell me." He said, "The men fled from the battle. Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead."

1.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：你怎么知道扫罗和他儿子约拿单死了呢？
1.en: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"

1.zh: 报信的少年人说：我偶然到基利波山，看见扫罗伏在自己枪上，有战车 、 马兵紧紧地追他。
1.en: "I happened to be on Mount Gilboa," the young man said, "and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and riders almost upon him.

1.zh: 他回头看见我，就呼叫我。我说：我在这里。
1.en: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, 'What can I do?'

1.zh: 他问我说：你是甚么人？我说：我是亚玛力人。
1.en: "He asked me, 'Who are you?' " 'An Amalekite,' I answered.

1.zh: 他说：请你来，将我杀死；因为痛苦抓住我，我的生命尚存。
1.en: "Then he said to me, 'Stand over me and kill me! I am in the throes of death, but I'm still alive.'

1.zh: 我准知他仆倒必不能活，就去将他杀死，把他头上的冠冕 、 臂上的镯子拿到我主这里。
1.en: "So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord."

1.zh: 大卫就撕裂衣服，跟随他的人也是如此，
1.en: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.

1.zh: 而且悲哀哭号，禁食到晚上，是因扫罗和他儿子约拿单，并耶和华的民以色列家的人，倒在刀下。
1.en: They mourned and wept and fasted till evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the army of the Lord and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

1.zh: 大卫问报信的少年人说：你是哪里的人？他说：我是亚玛力客人的儿子。
1.en: David said to the young man who brought him the report, "Where are you from?" "I am the son of an alien, an Amalekite," he answered.

1.zh: 大卫说：你伸手杀害耶和华的受膏者，怎么不畏惧呢？
1.en: David asked him, "Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord 's anointed?"

1.zh: 大卫叫了一个少年人来，说：你去杀他罢！
1.en: Then David called one of his men and said, "Go, strike him down!" So he struck him down, and he died.

1.zh: 大卫对他说：你流人血的罪归到自己的头上，因为你亲口作见证说：我杀了耶和华的受膏者。少年人就把他杀了。
1.en: For David had said to him, "Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, 'I killed the Lord 's anointed.' "

1.zh: 大卫作哀歌，吊扫罗和他儿子约拿单，
1.en: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,

1.zh: 且吩咐将这歌教导犹大人。这歌名叫弓歌，写在雅煞珥书上。
1.en: and ordered that the men of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):

1.zh: 歌中说：以色列啊，你尊荣者在山上被杀！大英雄何竟死亡！
1.en: "Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!

1.zh: 不要在迦特报告；不要在亚实基伦街上传扬；免得非利士的女子欢乐；免得未受割礼之人的女子矜夸。
1.en: "Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.

1.zh: 基利波山哪，愿你那里没有雨露！愿你田地无土产可作供物！因为英雄的盾牌在那里被污丢弃；扫罗的盾牌彷佛未曾抹油。
1.en: "O mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, nor fields that yield offerings of grain . For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul-no longer rubbed with oil.

1.zh: 约拿单的弓箭非流敌人的血不退缩；扫罗的刀剑非剖勇士的油不收回。
1.en: From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.

1.zh: 扫罗和约拿单 ─ 活时相悦相爱，死时也不分离 ─ 他们比鹰更快，比狮子还强。
1.en: "Saul and Jonathan- in life they were loved and gracious, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

1.zh: 以色列的女子啊，当为扫罗哭号！他曾使你们穿朱红色的美衣，使你们衣服有黄金的妆饰。
1.en: "O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.

1.zh: 英雄何竟在阵上仆倒！约拿单何竟在山上被杀！
1.en: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.

1.zh: 我兄约拿单哪，我为你悲伤！我甚喜悦你！你向我发的爱情奇妙非常，过于妇女的爱情。
1.en: I grieve for you, Jonathan my brother; you were very dear to me. Your love for me was wonderful, more wonderful than that of women.

1.zh: 英雄何竟仆倒！战具何竟灭没！
1.en: "How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!"

2.zh: 此后，大卫问耶和华说：我上犹大的一个城去可以么？耶和华说：可以。大卫说：我上哪一个城去呢？耶和华说：上希伯仑去。
2.en: In the course of time, David inquired of the Lord . "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The Lord said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the Lord answered.

2.zh: 于是大卫和他的两个妻 ─ 一个是耶斯列人亚希暖，一个是作过迦密人拿八妻的亚比该 ─ 都上那里去了。
2.en: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

2.zh: 大卫也将跟随他的人和他们各人的眷属一同带上去，住在希伯仑的城邑中。
2.en: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.

2.zh: 犹大人来到希伯仑，在那里膏大卫作犹大家的王。有人告诉大卫说：葬埋扫罗的是基列雅比人。
2.en: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. When David was told that it was the men of Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,

2.zh: 大卫就差人去见基列雅比人，对他们说：你们厚待你们的主 ─ 扫罗，将他葬埋。愿耶和华赐福与你们！
2.en: he sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead to say to them, "The Lord bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.

2.zh: 你们既行了这事，愿耶和华以慈爱诚实待你们，我也要为此厚待你们。
2.en: May the Lord now show you kindness and faithfulness, and I too will show you the same favor because you have done this.

2.zh: 现在你们的主 ─ 扫罗死了，犹大家已经膏我作他们的王，所以你们要刚强奋勇。
2.en: Now then, be strong and brave, for Saul your master is dead, and the house of Judah has anointed me king over them."

2.zh: 扫罗的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，曾将扫罗的儿子伊施波设带过河，到玛哈念，
2.en: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul's army, had taken Ish- Bosheth son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

2.zh: 立他作王，治理基列 、 亚书利 、 耶斯列 、 以法莲 、 便雅悯，和以色列众人。
2.en: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.

2.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设登基的时候年四十岁，作以色列王二年；惟独犹大家归从大卫。
2.en: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The house of Judah, however, followed David.

2.zh: 大卫在希伯仑作犹大家的王，共七年零六个月。
2.en: The length of time David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

2.zh: 尼珥的儿子押尼珥和扫罗的儿子伊施波设的仆人从玛哈念出来，往基遍去。
2.en: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

2.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押和大卫的仆人也出来，在基遍池旁与他们相遇；一班坐在池这边，一班坐在池那边。
2.en: Joab son of Zeruiah and David's men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.

2.zh: 押尼珥对约押说：让少年人起来，在我们面前戏耍罢！约押说：可以。
2.en: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let's have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us." "All right, let them do it," Joab said.

2.zh: 就按著定数起来：属扫罗儿子伊施波设的便雅悯人过去十二名，大卫的仆人也过去十二名，
2.en: So they stood up and were counted off-twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.

2.zh: 彼此揪头，用刀刺肋，一同仆倒。所以，那地叫作希利甲哈素林，就在基遍。
2.en: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent's side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

2.zh: 那日的战事凶猛，押尼珥和以色列人败在大卫的仆人面前。
2.en: The battle that day was very fierce, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by David's men.

2.zh: 在那里有洗鲁雅的三个儿子：约押 、 亚比筛 、 亚撒黑。亚撒黑脚快如野鹿一般；
2.en: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.

2.zh: 亚撒黑追赶押尼珥，直追赶他不偏左右。
2.en: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.

2.zh: 押尼珥回头说：你是亚撒黑么？回答说：是。
2.en: Abner looked behind him and asked, "Is that you, Asahel?" "It is," he answered.

2.zh: 押尼珥对他说：你或转向左转向右，拿住一个少年人，剥去他的战衣。亚撒黑却不肯转开不追赶他。
2.en: Then Abner said to him, "Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel would not stop chasing him.

2.zh: 押尼珥又对亚撒黑说：你转开不追赶我罢！我何必杀你呢？若杀你，有甚么脸见你哥哥约押呢？
2.en: Again Abner warned Asahel, "Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?"

2.zh: 亚撒黑仍不肯转开。故此，押尼珥就用枪 𨱔 刺入他的肚腹，甚至枪从背后透出，亚撒黑就在那里仆倒而死。众人赶到亚撒黑仆倒而死的地方，就都站住。
2.en: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel's stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.

2.zh: 约押和亚比筛追赶押尼珥，日落的时候，到了通基遍旷野的路旁，基亚对面的亚玛山。
2.en: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.

2.zh: 便雅悯人聚集，跟随押尼珥站在一个山顶上。
2.en: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.

2.zh: 押尼珥呼叫约押说：刀剑岂可永远杀人么？你岂不知终久必有苦楚么？你要等何时才叫百姓回去 、 不追赶弟兄呢？
2.en: Abner called out to Joab, "Must the sword devour forever? Don't you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their brothers?"

2.zh: 约押说：我指著永生的神起誓：你若不说戏耍的那句话，今日早晨百姓就回去，不追赶弟兄了。
2.en: Joab answered, "As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued the pursuit of their brothers until morning. "

2.zh: 于是约押吹角，众民就站住，不再追赶以色列人，也不再打仗了。
2.en: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the men came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.

2.zh: 押尼珥和跟随他的人整夜经过亚拉巴，过约但河，走过毕伦，到了玛哈念。
2.en: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the whole Bithron and came to Mahanaim.

2.zh: 约押追赶押尼珥回来，聚集众民，见大卫的仆人中缺少了十九个人和亚撒黑。
2.en: Then Joab returned from pursuing Abner and assembled all his men. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David's men were found missing.

2.zh: 但大卫的仆人杀了便雅悯人和跟随押尼珥的人，共三百六十名。
2.en: But David's men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.

2.zh: 众人将亚撒黑送到伯利恒，葬在他父亲的坟墓里。约押和跟随他的人走了一夜，天亮的时候到了希伯仑。
2.en: They took Asahel and buried him in his father's tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.

3.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战许久。大卫家日见强盛；扫罗家日见衰弱。
3.en: The war between the house of Saul and the house of David lasted a long time. David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.

3.zh: 大卫在希伯仑得了几个儿子：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖所生的；
3.en: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

3.zh: 次子基利押（在历代上三章一节作但以利）是作过迦密人拿八的妻亚比该所生的；三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦所生的；
3.en: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

3.zh: 四子亚多尼雅是哈及所生的；五子示法提雅是亚比他所生的；
3.en: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

3.zh: 六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉所生的。大卫这六个儿子都是在希伯仑生的。
3.en: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David's wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.

3.zh: 扫罗家和大卫家争战的时候，押尼珥在扫罗家大有权势。
3.en: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.

3.zh: 扫罗有一妃嫔，名叫利斯巴，是爱亚的女儿。一日，伊施波设对押尼珥说：你为甚么与我父的妃嫔同房呢？
3.en: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father's concubine?"

3.zh: 押尼珥因伊施波设的话就甚发怒，说：我岂是犹大的狗头呢？我恩待你父扫罗的家和他的弟兄 、 朋友，不将你交在大卫手里，今日你竟为这妇人责备我么？
3.en: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said and he answered, "Am I a dog's head-on Judah's side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven't handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!

3.zh: 我若不照著耶和华起誓应许大卫的话行，废去扫罗的位，建立大卫的位，使他治理以色列和犹大，从但直到别是巴，愿神重重地降罚与我！
3.en: May God deal with Abner, be it ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the Lord promised him on oath

3.zh: a
3.en: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David's throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba."

3.zh: 伊施波设惧怕押尼珥，不敢回答一句。
3.en: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.

3.zh: 押尼珥打发人去见大卫，替他说：这国归谁呢？又说：你与我立约，我必帮助你，使以色列人都归服你。
3.en: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, "Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you."

3.zh: 大卫说：好！我与你立约。但有一件，你来见我面的时候，若不将扫罗的女儿米甲带来，必不得见我的面。
3.en: "Good," said David. "I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me."

3.zh: 大卫就打发人去见扫罗的儿子伊施波设，说：你要将我的妻米甲归还我；他是我从前用一百非利士人的阳皮所聘定的。
3.en: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."

3.zh: 伊施波设就打发人去，将米甲从拉亿的儿子 、 他丈夫帕铁那里接回来。
3.en: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.

3.zh: 米甲的丈夫跟著他，一面走一面哭，直跟到巴户琳。押尼珥说：你回去罢！帕铁就回去了。
3.en: Her husband, however, went with her, weeping behind her all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, "Go back home!" So he went back.

3.zh: 押尼珥对以色列长老说：从前你们愿意大卫作王治理你们，
3.en: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, "For some time you have wanted to make David your king.

3.zh: 现在你们可以照心愿而行。因为耶和华曾论到大卫说：我必藉我仆人大卫的手，救我民以色列脱离非利士人和众仇敌的手。
3.en: Now do it! For the Lord promised David, 'By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.' "

3.zh: 押尼珥也用这话说给便雅悯人听，又到希伯仑，将以色列人和便雅悯全家一切所喜悦的事说给大卫听。
3.en: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole house of Benjamin wanted to do.

3.zh: 押尼珥带著二十个人来到希伯仑见大卫，大卫就为押尼珥和他带来的人设摆筵席。
3.en: When Abner, who had twenty men with him, came to David at Hebron, David prepared a feast for him and his men.

3.zh: 押尼珥对大卫说：我要起身去招聚以色列众人来见我主我王，与你立约，你就可以照著心愿作王。于是大卫送押尼珥去，押尼珥就平平安安地去了。
3.en: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a compact with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.

3.zh: 约押和大卫的仆人攻击敌军，带回许多的掠物。那时押尼珥不在希伯仑大卫那里，因大卫已经送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
3.en: Just then David's men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

3.zh: 约押和跟随他的全军到了，就有人告诉约押说：尼珥的儿子押尼珥来见王，王送他去，他也平平安安地去了。
3.en: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.

3.zh: 约押去见王说：你这是做甚么呢？押尼珥来见你，你为何送他去，他就踪影不见了呢？
3.en: So Joab went to the king and said, "What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you let him go? Now he is gone!

3.zh: 你当晓得，尼珥的儿子押尼珥来是要诓哄你，要知道你的出入和你一切所行的事。
3.en: You know Abner son of Ner; he came to deceive you and observe your movements and find out everything you are doing."

3.zh: 约押从大卫那里出来，就打发人去追赶押尼珥，在西拉井追上他，将他带回来，大卫却不知道。
3.en: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David did not know it.

3.zh: 押尼珥回到希伯仑，约押领他到城门的瓮洞，假作要与他说机密话，就在那里刺透他的肚腹，他便死了。这是报杀他兄弟亚撒黑的仇。
3.en: Now when Abner returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the gateway, as though to speak with him privately. And there, to avenge the blood of his brother Asahel, Joab stabbed him in the stomach, and he died.

3.zh: 大卫听见了，就说：流尼珥的儿子押尼珥的血，这罪在耶和华面前必永不归我和我的国。
3.en: Later, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the Lord concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.

3.zh: 愿流他血的罪归到约押头上和他父的全家；又愿约押家不断有患漏症的，长大痳疯的，架拐而行的，被刀杀死的，缺乏饮食的。
3.en: May his blood fall upon the head of Joab and upon all his father's house! May Joab's house never be without someone who has a running sore or leprosy or who leans on a crutch or who falls by the sword or who lacks food."

3.zh: 约押和他兄弟亚比筛杀了押尼珥，是因押尼珥在基遍争战的时候杀了他们的兄弟亚撒黑。
3.en: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)

3.zh: 大卫吩咐约押和跟随他的众人说：你们当撕裂衣服，腰束麻布，在押尼珥棺前哀哭。大卫王也跟在棺后。
3.en: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner." King David himself walked behind the bier.

3.zh: 他们将押尼珥葬在希伯仑。王在押尼珥的墓旁放声而哭，众民也都哭了。
3.en: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner's tomb. All the people wept also.

3.zh: 王为押尼珥举哀，说：押尼珥何竟像愚顽人死呢？
3.en: The king sang this lament for Abner: "Should Abner have died as the lawless die?

3.zh: 你手未曾捆绑，脚未曾锁住。你死，如人死在罪孽之辈手下一样。于是众民又为押尼珥哀哭。
3.en: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before wicked men." And all the people wept over him again.

3.zh: 日头未落的时候，众民来劝大卫吃饭，但大卫起誓说：我若在日头未落以前吃饭，或吃别物，愿神重重地降罚与我！
3.en: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!"

3.zh: 众民知道了就都喜悦。凡王所行的，众民无不喜悦。
3.en: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.

3.zh: 那日，以色列众民才知道杀尼珥的儿子押尼珥并非出于王意。
3.en: So on that day all the people and all Israel knew that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.

3.zh: 王对臣仆说：你们岂不知今日以色列人中死了一个作元帅的大丈夫么？
3.en: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a prince and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?

3.zh: 我虽然受膏为王，今日还是软弱；这洗鲁雅的两个儿子比我刚强。愿耶和华照著恶人所行的恶报应他。
3.en: And today, though I am the anointed king, I am weak, and these sons of Zeruiah are too strong for me. May the Lord repay the evildoer according to his evil deeds!"

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设听见押尼珥死在希伯仑，手就发软；以色列众人也都惊惶
4.en: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子伊施波设有两个军长，一名巴拿，一名利甲，是便雅悯支派 、 比录人临门的儿子。比录也属便雅悯。
4.en: Now Saul's son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Recab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin-Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,

4.zh: 比录人早先逃到基他音，在那里寄居，直到今日。
4.en: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have lived there as aliens to this day.

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子约拿单有一个儿子名叫米非波设，是瘸腿的。扫罗和约拿单死亡的消息从耶斯列传到的时候，他才五岁。他乳母抱著他逃跑；因为跑得太急，孩子掉在地上，腿就瘸了。
4.en: (Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in both feet. He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she hurried to leave, he fell and became crippled. His name was Mephibosheth.)

4.zh: 一日，比录人临门的两个儿子利甲和巴拿出去，约在午热的时候到了伊施波设的家；伊施波设正睡午觉。
4.en: Now Recab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.

4.zh: 他们进了房子，假作要取麦子，就刺透伊施波设的肚腹，逃跑了。
4.en: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Recab and his brother Baanah slipped away.

4.zh: 他们进房子的时候，伊施波设正在卧房里躺在床上，他们将他杀死，割了他的首级，拿著首级在亚拉巴走了一夜，
4.en: They had gone into the house while he was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed and killed him, they cut off his head. Taking it with them, they traveled all night by way of the Arabah.

4.zh: 将伊施波设的首级拿到希伯仑见大卫王，说：王的仇敌扫罗曾寻索王的性命。看哪，这是他儿子伊施波设的首级；耶和华今日为我主我王在扫罗和他后裔的身上报了仇。
4.en: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to take your life. This day the Lord has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring."

4.zh: 大卫对比录人临门的儿子利甲和他兄弟巴拿说：我指著救我性命脱离一切苦难 、 永生的耶和华起誓：
4.en: David answered Recab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As surely as the Lord lives, who has delivered me out of all trouble,

4.zh: 从前有人报告我说，扫罗死了，他自以为报好消息；我就拿住他，将他杀在洗革拉，这就作了他报消息的赏赐。
4.en: when a man told me, 'Saul is dead,' and thought he was bringing good news, I seized him and put him to death in Ziklag. That was the reward I gave him for his news!

4.zh: 何况恶人将义人杀在他的床上，我岂不向你们讨流他血的罪 、 从世上除灭你们呢？
4.en: How much more-when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed-should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!"

4.zh: 于是大卫吩咐少年人将他们杀了，砍断他们的手脚，挂在希伯仑的池旁，却将伊施波设的首级葬在希伯仑押尼珥的坟墓里。
4.en: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner's tomb at Hebron.

5.zh: 以色列众支派来到希伯仑见大卫，说：我们原是你的骨肉。
5.en: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

5.zh: 从前扫罗作我们王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华也曾应许你说：你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。
5.en: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the Lord said to you, 'You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.' "

5.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯仑见大卫王，大卫在希伯仑耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王。
5.en: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a compact with them at Hebron before the Lord , and they anointed David king over Israel.

5.zh: 大卫登基的时候年三十岁，在位四十年；
5.en: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.

5.zh: 在希伯仑作犹大王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作以色列和犹大王三十三年。
5.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

5.zh: 大卫和跟随他的人到了耶路撒冷，要攻打住那地方的耶布斯人。耶布斯人对大卫说：你若不赶出瞎子 、 瘸子，必不能进这地方；心里想大卫决不能进去。
5.en: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, "You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off." They thought, "David cannot get in here."

5.zh: 然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
5.en: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion, the City of David.

5.zh: 当日，大卫说：谁攻打耶布斯人，当上水沟攻打我心里所恨恶的瘸子 、 瞎子。从此有俗语说：在那里有瞎子 、 瘸子，他不能进屋去。
5.en: On that day, David said, "Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those 'lame and blind' who are David's enemies. " That is why they say, "The 'blind and lame' will not enter the palace."

5.zh: 大卫住在保障里，给保障起名叫大卫城。大卫又从米罗以里，周围筑墙。
5.en: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the supporting terraces inward.

5.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为耶和华 ─ 万军之神与他同在。
5.en: And he became more and more powerful, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.

5.zh: 推罗王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和木匠 、 石匠给大卫建造宫殿。
5.en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.

5.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列使他的国兴旺。
5.en: And David knew that the Lord had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel.

5.zh: 大卫离开希伯仑之后，在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。
5.en: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.

5.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是沙母亚 、 朔罢 、 拿单 、 所罗门 、
5.en: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

5.zh: 益辖 、 以利书亚 、 尼斐 、 雅非亚 、
5.en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

5.zh: 以利沙玛 、 以利雅大 、 以利法列。
5.en: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.

5.zh: 非利士人听见人膏大卫作以色列王，非利士人就上来寻索大卫；大卫听见，就下到保障。
5.en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

5.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。
5.en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

5.zh: 大卫求问耶和华说：我可以上去攻打非利士人么？你将他们交在我手里么？耶和华说：你可以上去，我必将非利士人交在你手里。
5.en: so David inquired of the Lord , "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The Lord answered him, "Go, for I will surely hand the Philistines over to you."

5.zh: 大卫来到巴力毗拉心，在那里击杀非利士人，说：耶和华在我面前冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般。因此称那地方为巴力毗拉心。
5.en: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, the Lord has broken out against my enemies before me." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

5.zh: 非利士人将偶像撇在那里，大卫和跟随他的人拿去了。
5.en: The Philistines abandoned their idols there, and David and his men carried them off.

5.zh: 非利士人又上来，布散在利乏音谷。
5.en: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

5.zh: 大卫求问耶和华；耶和华说：不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。
5.en: so David inquired of the Lord , and he answered, "Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

5.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要急速前去，因为那时耶和华已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。
5.en: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because that will mean the Lord has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

5.zh: 大卫就遵著耶和华所吩咐的去行，攻打非利士人，从迦巴直到基色。
5.en: So David did as the Lord commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

6.zh: 大卫又聚集以色列中所有挑选的人三万。
6.en: David again brought together out ofIsrael chosen men, thirty thousand in all.

6.zh: 大卫起身，率领跟随他的众人前往，要从巴拉犹大将神的约柜运来；这约柜就是坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华留名的约柜。
6.en: He and all his men set out from Baalah of Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim that are on the ark.

6.zh: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上；亚比拿达的两个儿子乌撒和亚希约赶这新车。
6.en: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart

6.zh: 他们将神的约柜从冈上亚比拿达家里抬出来的时候，亚希约在柜前行走。
6.en: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.

6.zh: 大卫和以色列的全家在耶和华面前，用松木制造的各样乐器和琴 、 瑟 、 鼓 、 钹 、 锣，作乐跳舞。
6.en: David and the whole house of Israel were celebrating with all their might before the Lord , with songs and with harps, lyres, tambourines, sistrums and cymbals.

6.zh: 到了拿艮的禾场，因为牛失前蹄（或译：惊跳），乌撒就伸手扶住神的约柜。
6.en: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God, because the oxen stumbled.

6.zh: 神耶和华向乌撒发怒，因这错误击杀他，他就死在神的约柜旁。
6.en: The Lord 's anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down and he died there beside the ark of God.

6.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀（原文是闯杀）乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯乌撒，直到今日。
6.en: Then David was angry because the Lord 's wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

6.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕耶和华，说：耶和华的约柜怎可运到我这里来？
6.en: David was afraid of the Lord that day and said, "How can the ark of the Lord ever come to me?"

6.zh: 于是大卫不肯将耶和华的约柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别以东的家中。
6.en: He was not willing to take the ark of the Lord to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

6.zh: 耶和华的约柜在迦特人俄别以东家中三个月；耶和华赐福给俄别以东和他的全家。
6.en: The ark of the Lord remained in the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite for three months, and the Lord blessed him and his entire household.

6.zh: 有人告诉大卫王说：耶和华因为约柜赐福给俄别以东的家和一切属他的。大卫就去，欢欢喜喜地将神的约柜从俄别以东家中抬到大卫的城里。
6.en: Now King David was told, "The Lord has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God." So David went down and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.

6.zh: 抬耶和华约柜的人走了六步，大卫就献牛与肥羊为祭。
6.en: When those who were carrying the ark of the Lord had taken six steps, he sacrificed a bull and a fattened calf.

6.zh: 大卫穿著细麻布的以弗得，在耶和华面前极力跳舞。
6.en: David, wearing a linen ephod, danced before the Lord with all his might,

6.zh: 这样，大卫和以色列的全家欢呼吹角，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
6.en: while he and the entire house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouts and the sound of trumpets.

6.zh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王在耶和华面前踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
6.en: As the ark of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the Lord , she despised him in her heart.

6.zh: 众人将耶和华的约柜请进去，安放在所预备的地方，就是在大卫所搭的帐幕里。大卫在耶和华面前献燔祭和平安祭。
6.en: They brought the ark of the Lord and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the Lord .

6.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉万军之耶和华的名给民祝福，
6.en: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord Almighty.

6.zh: 并且分给以色列众人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块肉，一个葡萄饼；众人就各回各家去了。
6.en: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.

6.zh: 大卫回家要给眷属祝福；扫罗的女儿米甲出来迎接他，说：以色列王今日在臣仆的婢女眼前露体，如同一个轻贱人无耻露体一样，有好大的荣耀啊！
6.en: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, "How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, disrobing in the sight of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!"

6.zh: 大卫对米甲说：这是在耶和华面前；耶和华已拣选我，废了你父和你父的全家，立我作耶和华民以色列的君，所以我必在耶和华面前跳舞。
6.en: David said to Michal, "It was before the Lord , who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the Lord 's people Israel-I will celebrate before the Lord .

6.zh: 我也必更加卑微，自己看为轻贱。你所说的那些婢女，他们倒要尊敬我。
6.en: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor."

6.zh: 扫罗的女儿米甲，直到死日，没有生养儿女。
6.en: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.

7.zh: 王住在自己宫中，耶和华使他安靖，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。
7.en: After the king was settled in his palace and the Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him,

7.zh: 那时，王对先知拿单说：看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，神的约柜反在幔子里。
7.en: he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a palace of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent."

7.zh: 拿单对王说：你可以照你的心意而行，因为耶和华与你同在。
7.en: Nathan replied to the king, "Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you."

7.zh: 当夜，耶和华的话临到拿单说：
7.en: That night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:

7.zh: 你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：你岂可建造殿宇给我居住呢？
7.en: "Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the Lord says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?

7.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，常在会幕和帐幕中行走。
7.en: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt to this day. I have been moving from place to place with a tent as my dwelling.

7.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列一支派的士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民以色列的说：你们为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？
7.en: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" '

7.zh: 现在，你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
7.en: "Now then, tell my servant David, 'This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture and from following the flock to be ruler over my people Israel.

7.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌。我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
7.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest men of the earth.

7.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
7.en: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

7.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必使你安靖，不被一切仇敌扰乱，并且我 ─ 耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
7.en: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. " 'The Lord declares to you that the Lord himself will establish a house for you:

7.zh: 你寿数满足 、 与你列祖同睡的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位；我也必坚定他的国。
7.en: When your days are over and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.

7.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。
7.en: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

7.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；他若犯了罪，我必用人的杖责打他，用人的鞭责罚他。
7.en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with the rod of men, with floggings inflicted by men.

7.zh: 但我的慈爱仍不离开他，像离开在你面前所废弃的扫罗一样。
7.en: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.

7.zh: 你的家和你的国必在我（原文是你）面前永远坚立。你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。
7.en: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me ; your throne will be established forever.' "

7.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示，告诉大卫。
7.en: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

7.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：主耶和华啊，我是谁？我的家算甚么？你竟使我到这地步呢？
7.en: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, O Sovereign Lord , and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。主耶和华啊，这岂是人所常遇的事么？
7.en: And as if this were not enough in your sight, O Sovereign Lord , you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant. Is this your usual way of dealing with man, O Sovereign Lord ?

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，我还有何言可以对你说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
7.en: "What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, O Sovereign Lord .

7.zh: 你行这大事使仆人知道，是因你所应许的话，也是照你的心意。
7.en: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，你本为大，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的；除你以外再无神。
7.en: "How great you are, O Sovereign Lord ! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

7.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人和他们的神，显出你的大名。
7.en: And who is like your people Israel-the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

7.zh: 你曾坚立你的民以色列作你的子民，直到永远；你 ─ 耶和华也作了他们的神。
7.en: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, O Lord , have become their God.

7.zh: 耶和华神啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远；照你所说的而行。
7.en: "And now, Lord God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,

7.zh: 愿人永远尊你的名为大，说：万军之耶和华是治理以色列的神。这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
7.en: so that your name will be great forever. Then men will say, 'The Lord Almighty is God over Israel!' And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

7.zh: 万军之耶和华 ─ 以色列的神啊，因你启示你的仆人说：我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆向你如此祈祷。
7.en: "O Lord Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, 'I will build a house for you.' So your servant has found courage to offer you this prayer.

7.zh: 主耶和华啊，惟有你是神。你的话是真实的；你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
7.en: O Sovereign Lord , you are God! Your words are trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.

7.zh: 现在求你赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。主耶和华啊，这是你所应许的。愿你永远赐福与仆人的家！
7.en: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, O Sovereign Lord , have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever."

8.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了京城的权柄（原文是母城的嚼环）；
8.en: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.

8.zh: 又攻打摩押人，使他们躺卧在地上，用绳量一量：量二绳的杀了，量一绳的存留。摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
8.en: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought tribute.

8.zh: 琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢往大河去，要夺回他的国权。大卫就攻打他，
8.en: Moreover, David fought Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his control along the Euphrates River.

8.zh: 擒拿了他的马兵一千七百，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车 . 的马。
8.en: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

8.zh: 大马色的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大底谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
8.en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

8.zh: 于是大卫在大马色的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
8.en: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

8.zh: 他夺了哈大底谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌，带到耶路撒冷。
8.en: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

8.zh: 大卫王又从属哈大底谢的比他和比罗他城中夺取了许多的铜。
8.en: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

8.zh: 哈马王陀以听见大卫杀败哈大底谢的全军，
8.en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,

8.zh: 就打发他儿子约兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大底谢（原来陀以与哈大底谢常常争战）。约兰带了金银铜的器皿来，
8.en: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze.

8.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿和他治服各国所得来的金银都分别为圣，献给耶和华，
8.en: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:

8.zh: 就是从亚兰 、 摩押 、 亚扪 、 非利士 、 亚玛力人所得来的，以及从琐巴王利合的儿子哈大底谢所掠之物。
8.en: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

8.zh: 大卫在盐谷击杀了亚兰（或译：以东，见诗篇六十篇诗题）一万八千人回来，就得了大名；
8.en: And David became famous after he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

8.zh: 又在以东全地设立防营，以东人就都归服大卫。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
8.en: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory wherever he went.

8.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
8.en: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

8.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
8.en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

8.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长；西莱雅作书记；
8.en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;

8.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都作领袖。
8.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were royal advisers.

9.zh: 大卫问说：扫罗家还有剩下的人没有？我要因约拿单的缘故向他施恩。
9.en: David asked, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan's sake?"

9.zh: 扫罗家有一个仆人，名叫洗巴，有人叫他来见大卫，王问他说：你是洗巴么。回答说：仆人是。
9.en: Now there was a servant of Saul's household named Ziba. They called him to appear before David, and the king said to him, "Are you Ziba?" "Your servant," he replied.

9.zh: 王说：扫罗家还有人没有？我要照神的慈爱恩待他。洗巴对王说：还有约拿单的一个儿子，是瘸腿的。
9.en: The king asked, "Is there no one still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show God's kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in both feet."

9.zh: 王说：他在哪里？洗巴对王说：他在罗底巴，亚米利的儿子玛吉家里。
9.en: "Where is he?" the king asked. Ziba answered, "He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar."

9.zh: 于是大卫王打发人去，从罗底巴亚米利的儿子玛吉家里召了他来。
9.en: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.

9.zh: 扫罗的孙子 、 约拿单的儿子米非波设来见大卫，伏地叩拜。大卫说：米非波设！米非波设说：仆人在此。
9.en: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, "Mephibosheth!" "Your servant," he replied.

9.zh: 大卫说：你不要惧怕，我必因你父亲约拿单的缘故施恩与你，将你祖父扫罗的一切田地都归还你；你也可以常与我同席吃饭。
9.en: "Don't be afraid," David said to him, "for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."

9.zh: 米非波设又叩拜，说：仆人算甚么，不过如死狗一般，竟蒙王这样眷顾！
9.en: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, "What is your servant, that you should notice a dead dog like me?"

9.zh: 王召了扫罗的仆人洗巴来，对他说：我已将属扫罗和他的一切家产都赐给你主人的儿子了。
9.en: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul's servant, and said to him, "I have given your master's grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

9.zh: 你和你的众子 、 仆人要为你主人的儿子米非波设耕种田地，把所产的拿来供他食用；他却要常与我同席吃饭。洗巴有十五个儿子，二十个仆人。
9.en: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master's grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table." (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)

9.zh: 洗巴对王说：凡我主我王吩咐仆人的，仆人都必遵行。王又说：米非波设必与我同席吃饭，如王的儿子一样。
9.en: Then Ziba said to the king, "Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do." So Mephibosheth ate at David's table like one of the king's sons.

9.zh: 米非波设有一个小儿子，名叫米迦。凡住在洗巴家里的人都作了米非波设的仆人。
9.en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all the members of Ziba's household were servants of Mephibosheth.

9.zh: 于是米非波设住在耶路撒冷，常与王同席吃饭。他两腿都是瘸的。
9.en: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king's table, and he was crippled in both feet.

10.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王死了，他儿子哈嫩接续他作王。
10.en: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.

10.zh: 大卫说：我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。于是大卫差遣臣仆，为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内。
10.en: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David's men came to the land of the Ammonites,

10.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对他们的主哈嫩说：大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲么？他差臣仆来不是详察窥探 、 要倾覆这城么？
10.en: the Ammonite nobles said to Hanun their lord, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending men to you to express sympathy? Hasn't David sent them to you to explore the city and spy it out and overthrow it?"

10.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
10.en: So Hanun seized David's men, shaved off half of each man's beard, cut off their garments in the middle at the buttocks, and sent them away.

10.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，（因为他们甚觉羞耻），告诉他们说：可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。
10.en: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

10.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，就打发人去，招募伯利合的亚兰人和琐巴的亚兰人，步兵二万，与玛迦王的人一千 、 陀伯人一万二千。
10.en: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench in David's nostrils, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maacah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.

10.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
10.en: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

10.zh: 亚扪人出来，在城门前摆阵；琐巴与利合的亚兰人 、 陀伯人，并玛迦人，另在郊野摆阵。
10.en: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.

10.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对著亚兰人摆阵。
10.en: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

10.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对著亚扪人摆阵。
10.en: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.

10.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
10.en: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.

10.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和神的城邑作大丈夫。愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行！
10.en: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."

10.zh: 于是，约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
10.en: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

10.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就离开亚扪人那里，回耶路撒冷去了。
10.en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.

10.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就又聚集。
10.en: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.

10.zh: 哈大底谢差遣人，将大河那边的亚兰人调来；他们到了希兰，哈大底谢的将军朔法率领他们。
10.en: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the River ; they went to Helam, with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.

10.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人，过约但河，来到希兰。亚兰人迎著大卫摆阵，与他打仗。
10.en: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.

10.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑；大卫杀了亚兰七百辆战车的人，四万马兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
10.en: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobach the commander of their army, and he died there.

10.zh: 属哈大底谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与以色列人和好，归服他们。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
10.en: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.

11.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，大卫又差派约押，率领臣仆和以色列众人出战。他们就打败亚扪人，围攻拉巴。大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。
11.en: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king's men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.

11.zh: 一日，太阳平西，大卫从床上起来，在王宫的平顶上游行，看见一个妇人沐浴，容貌甚美，
11.en: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

11.zh: 大卫就差人打听那妇人是谁。有人说：他是以连的女儿，赫人乌利亚的妻拔示巴。
11.en: and David sent someone to find out about her. The man said, "Isn't this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite?"

11.zh: 大卫差人去，将妇人接来；那时他的月经才得洁净。他来了，大卫与他同房，他就回家去了。
11.en: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (She had purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she went back home.

11.zh: 于是他怀了孕，打发人去告诉大卫说：我怀了孕。
11.en: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, "I am pregnant."

11.zh: 大卫差人到约押那里，说：你打发赫人乌利亚到我这里来。约押就打发乌利亚去见大卫。
11.en: So David sent this word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent him to David.

11.zh: 乌利亚来了，大卫问约押好，也问兵好，又问争战的事怎样。
11.en: When Uriah came to him, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were and how the war was going.

11.zh: 大卫对乌利亚说：你回家去，洗洗脚罢！乌利亚出了王宫，随后王送他一分食物。
11.en: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

11.zh: 乌利亚却和他主人的仆人一同睡在宫门外，没有回家去。
11.en: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master's servants and did not go down to his house.

11.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：乌利亚没有回家去。大卫就问乌利亚说：你从远路上来，为甚么不回家去呢？
11.en: When David was told, "Uriah did not go home," he asked him, "Haven't you just come from a distance? Why didn't you go home?"

11.zh: 乌利亚对大卫说：约柜和以色列与犹大兵都住在棚里，我主约押和我主（或译：王）的仆人都在田野安营，我岂可回家吃喝 、 与妻子同寝呢？我敢在王面前起誓（原文是我指著王和王的性命起誓）：我决不行这事！
11.en: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my master Joab and my lord's men are camped in the open fields. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and lie with my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!"

11.zh: 大卫吩咐乌利亚说：你今日仍住在这里，明日我打发你去。于是乌利亚那日和次日住在耶路撒冷。
11.en: Then David said to him, "Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.

11.zh: 大卫召了乌利亚来，叫他在自己面前吃喝，使他喝醉。到了晚上，乌利亚出去与他主的仆人一同住宿，还没有回到家里去。
11.en: At David's invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master's servants; he did not go home.

11.zh: 次日早晨，大卫写信与约押，交乌利亚随手带去。
11.en: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.

11.zh: 信内写著说：要派乌利亚前进，到阵势极险之处，你们便退后，使他被杀。
11.en: In it he wrote, "Put Uriah in the front line where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die."

11.zh: 约押围城的时候，知道敌人那里有勇士，便将乌利亚派在那里。
11.en: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.

11.zh: 城里的人出来和约押打仗；大卫的仆人中有几个被杀的，赫人乌利亚也死了。
11.en: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David's army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.

11.zh: 于是，约押差人去将争战的一切事告诉大卫，
11.en: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.

11.zh: 又嘱咐使者说：你把争战的一切事对王说完了，
11.en: He instructed the messenger: "When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,

11.zh: 王若发怒，问你说：你们打仗为甚么挨近城墙呢？岂不知敌人必从城上射箭么？
11.en: the king's anger may flare up, and he may ask you, 'Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn't you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?

11.zh: 从前打死耶路比设（就是耶路巴力，见士师记九章一节）儿子亚比米勒的是谁呢？岂不是一个妇人从城上抛下一块上磨石来，打在他身上，他就死在提备斯么？你们为甚么挨近城墙呢？你就说：王的仆人 ─ 赫人乌利亚也死了。
11.en: Who killed Abimelech son of Jerub-Besheth ? Didn't a woman throw an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?' If he asks you this, then say to him, 'Also, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.' "

11.zh: 使者起身，来见大卫，照著约押所吩咐他的话奏告大卫。
11.en: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.

11.zh: 使者对大卫说：敌人强过我们，出到郊野与我们打仗，我们追杀他们，直到城门口。
11.en: The messenger said to David, "The men overpowered us and came out against us in the open, but we drove them back to the entrance to the city gate.

11.zh: 射箭的从城上射王的仆人，射死几个，赫人乌利亚也死了。
11.en: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king's men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead."

11.zh: 王向使者说：你告诉约押说：不要因这事愁闷，刀剑或吞灭这人或吞灭那人，没有一定的；你只管竭力攻城，将城倾覆。可以用这话勉励约押。
11.en: David told the messenger, "Say this to Joab: 'Don't let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.' Say this to encourage Joab."

11.zh: 乌利亚的妻听见丈夫乌利亚死了，就为他哀哭。
11.en: When Uriah's wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.

11.zh: 哀哭的日子过了，大卫差人将他接到宫里，他就作了大卫的妻，给大卫生了一个儿子。但大卫所行的这事，耶和华甚不喜悦。
11.en: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the Lord .

12.zh: 耶和华差遣拿单去见大卫。拿单到了大卫那里，对他说：在一座城里有两个人：一个是富户，一个是穷人。
12.en: The Lord sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, "There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.

12.zh: 富户有许多牛群羊群；
12.en: The rich man had a very large number of sheep and cattle,

12.zh: 穷人除了所买来养活的一只小母羊羔之外，别无所有。羊羔在他家里和他儿女一同长大，吃他所吃的，喝他所喝的，睡在他怀中，在他看来如同女儿一样。
12.en: but the poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food, drank from his cup and even slept in his arms. It was like a daughter to him.

12.zh: 有一客人来到这富户家里；富户舍不得从自己的牛群羊群中取一只预备给客人吃，却取了那穷人的羊羔，预备给客人吃。
12.en: "Now a traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare a meal for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the ewe lamb that belonged to the poor man and prepared it for the one who had come to him."

12.zh: 大卫就甚恼怒那人，对拿单说：我指著永生的耶和华起誓，行这事的人该死！
12.en: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, "As surely as the Lord lives, the man who did this deserves to die!

12.zh: 他必偿还羊羔四倍；因为他行这事，没有怜恤的心。
12.en: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity."

12.zh: 拿单对大卫说：你就是那人！耶和华 ─ 以色列的神如此说：我膏你作以色列的王，救你脱离扫罗的手。
12.en: Then Nathan said to David, "You are the man! This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: 'I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.

12.zh: 我将你主人的家业赐给你，将你主人的妻交在你怀里，又将以色列和犹大家赐给你；你若还以为不足，我早就加倍地赐给你。
12.en: I gave your master's house to you, and your master's wives into your arms. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah. And if all this had been too little, I would have given you even more.

12.zh: 你为甚么藐视耶和华的命令，行他眼中看为恶的事呢？你借亚扪人的刀杀害赫人乌利亚，又娶了他的妻为妻。
12.en: Why did you despise the word of the Lord by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.

12.zh: 你既藐视我，娶了赫人乌利亚的妻为妻，所以刀剑必永不离开你的家。
12.en: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.'

12.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必从你家中兴起祸患攻击你；我必在你眼前把你的妃嫔赐给别人，他在日光之下就与他们同寝。
12.en: "This is what the Lord says: 'Out of your own household I am going to bring calamity upon you. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to one who is close to you, and he will lie with your wives in broad daylight.

12.zh: 你在暗中行这事，我却要在以色列众人面前，日光之下，报应你。
12.en: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.' "

12.zh: 大卫对拿单说：我得罪耶和华了！拿单说：耶和华已经除掉你的罪，你必不至于死。
12.en: Then David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the Lord ." Nathan replied, "The Lord has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.

12.zh: 只是你行这事，叫耶和华的仇敌大得亵渎的机会，故此，你所得的孩子必定要死。
12.en: But because by doing this you have made the enemies of the Lord show utter contempt, the son born to you will die."

12.zh: 拿单就回家去了。耶和华击打乌利亚妻给大卫所生的孩子，使他得重病。
12.en: After Nathan had gone home, the Lord struck the child that Uriah's wife had borne to David, and he became ill.

12.zh: 所以大卫为这孩子恳求神，而且禁食，进入内室，终夜躺在地上。
12.en: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and went into his house and spent the nights lying on the ground.

12.zh: 他家中的老臣来到他旁边，要把他从地上扶起来，他却不肯起来，也不同他们吃饭。
12.en: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.

12.zh: 到第七日，孩子死了。大卫的臣仆不敢告诉他孩子死了，因他们说：孩子还活著的时候，我们劝他，他尚且不肯听我们的话，若告诉他孩子死了，岂不更加忧伤么？
12.en: On the seventh day the child died. David's servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they thought, "While the child was still living, we spoke to David but he would not listen to us. How can we tell him the child is dead? He may do something desperate."

12.zh: 大卫见臣仆彼此低声说话，就知道孩子死了，问臣仆说：孩子死了么？他们说：死了。
12.en: David noticed that his servants were whispering among themselves and he realized the child was dead. "Is the child dead?" he asked. "Yes," they replied, "he is dead."

12.zh: 大卫就从地上起来，沐浴，抹膏，换了衣裳，进耶和华的殿敬拜；然后回宫，吩咐人摆饭，他便吃了。
12.en: Then David got up from the ground. After he had washed, put on lotions and changed his clothes, he went into the house of the Lord and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they served him food, and he ate.

12.zh: 臣仆问他说：你所行的是甚么意思？孩子活著的时候，你禁食哭泣；孩子死了，你倒起来吃饭。
12.en: His servants asked him, "Why are you acting this way? While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat!"

12.zh: 大卫说：孩子还活著，我禁食哭泣；因为我想，或者耶和华怜恤我，使孩子不死也未可知。
12.en: He answered, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, 'Who knows? The Lord may be gracious to me and let the child live.'

12.zh: 孩子死了，我何必禁食，我岂能使他返回呢？我必往他那里去，他却不能回我这里来。
12.en: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me."

12.zh: 大卫安慰他的妻拔示巴，与他同寝，他就生了儿子，给他起名叫所罗门。耶和华也喜爱他，
12.en: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and lay with her. She gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. The Lord loved him;

12.zh: 就藉先知拿单赐他一个名字，叫耶底底亚，因为耶和华爱他。
12.en: and because the Lord loved him, he sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah.

12.zh: 约押攻取亚扪人的京城拉巴。
12.en: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.

12.zh: 约押打发使者去见大卫，说：我攻打拉巴，取其水城。
12.en: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, "I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.

12.zh: 现在你要聚集其余的军兵来，安营围攻这城，恐怕我取了这城，人就以我的名叫这城。
12.en: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me."

12.zh: 于是大卫聚集众军，往拉巴去攻城，就取了这城，
12.en: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.

12.zh: 夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕（王：或译玛勒堪；玛勒堪就是米勒公，又名摩洛，亚扪族之神名），其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌著宝石。人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
12.en: He took the crown from the head of their king - its weight was a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones-and it was placed on David's head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

12.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下，或叫他经过砖窑（或译：强他们用锯，或用打粮食的铁器，或用铁斧做工，或使在砖窑里服役）；大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后，大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
12.en: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes, and he made them work at brickmaking. He did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.

13.zh: 大卫的儿子押沙龙有一个美貌的妹子，名叫他玛。大卫的儿子暗嫩爱他。
13.en: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.

13.zh: 暗嫩为他妹子他玛忧急成病。他玛还是处女，暗嫩以为难向他行事。
13.en: Amnon became frustrated to the point of illness on account of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.

13.zh: 暗嫩有一个朋友，名叫约拿达，是大卫长兄示米亚的儿子。这约拿达为人极其狡猾。
13.en: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.

13.zh: 他问暗嫩说：王的儿子啊，为何一天比一天瘦弱呢？请你告诉我。暗嫩回答说：我爱我兄弟押沙龙的妹子他玛。
13.en: He asked Amnon, "Why do you, the king's son, look so haggard morning after morning? Won't you tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I'm in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister."

13.zh: 约拿达说：你不如躺在床上装病；你父亲来看你，就对他说：求父叫我妹子他玛来，在我眼前预备食物，递给我吃，使我看见，好从他手里接过来吃。
13.en: "Go to bed and pretend to be ill," Jonadab said. "When your father comes to see you, say to him, 'I would like my sister Tamar to come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I may watch her and then eat it from her hand.' "

13.zh: 于是暗嫩躺卧装病。王来看他，他对王说：求父叫我妹子他玛来，在我眼前为我做两个饼，我好从他手里接过来吃。
13.en: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, "I would like my sister Tamar to come and make some special bread in my sight, so I may eat from her hand."

13.zh: 大卫就打发人到宫里，对他玛说：你往你哥哥暗嫩的屋里去，为他预备食物。
13.en: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: "Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him."

13.zh: 他玛就到他哥哥暗嫩的屋里；暗嫩正躺卧。他玛抟面，在他眼前做饼，且烤熟了，
13.en: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made the bread in his sight and baked it.

13.zh: 在他面前将饼从锅里倒出来，他却不肯吃，便说：众人离开我出去罢！众人就都离开他，出去了。
13.en: Then she took the pan and served him the bread, but he refused to eat. "Send everyone out of here," Amnon said. So everyone left him.

13.zh: 暗嫩对他玛说：你把食物拿进卧房，我好从你手里接过来吃。他玛就把所做的饼拿进卧房，到他哥哥暗嫩那里，
13.en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food here into my bedroom so I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the bread she had prepared and brought it to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.

13.zh: 拿著饼上前给他吃，他便拉住他玛，说：我妹妹，你来与我同寝。
13.en: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, "Come to bed with me, my sister."

13.zh: 他玛说：我哥哥，不要玷辱我。以色列人中不当这样行，你不要做这丑事；
13.en: "Don't, my brother!" she said to him. "Don't force me. Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don't do this wicked thing.

13.zh: 你玷辱了我，我何以掩盖我的羞耻呢？你在以色列中也成了愚妄人。你可以求王，他必不禁止我归你。
13.en: What about me? Where could I get rid of my disgrace? And what about you? You would be like one of the wicked fools in Israel. Please speak to the king; he will not keep me from being married to you."

13.zh: 但暗嫩不肯听他的话，因比他力大，就玷辱他，与他同寝。
13.en: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.

13.zh: 随后，暗嫩极其恨他，那恨他的心比先前爱他的心更甚，对他说：你起来，去罢！
13.en: Then Amnon hated her with intense hatred. In fact, he hated her more than he had loved her. Amnon said to her, "Get up and get out!"

13.zh: 他玛说：不要这样！你赶出我去的这罪比你才行的更重！但暗嫩不肯听他的话，
13.en: "No!" she said to him. "Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me." But he refused to listen to her.

13.zh: 就叫伺候自己的仆人来，说：将这个女子赶出去！他一出去，你就关门，上闩。
13.en: He called his personal servant and said, "Get this woman out of here and bolt the door after her."

13.zh: 那时他玛穿著彩衣，因为没有出嫁的公主都是这样穿。暗嫩的仆人就把他赶出去，关门上闩。
13.en: So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her. She was wearing a richly ornamented robe, for this was the kind of garment the virgin daughters of the king wore.

13.zh: 他玛把灰尘撒在头上，撕裂所穿的彩衣，以手抱头，一面行走，一面哭喊。
13.en: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornamented robe she was wearing. She put her hand on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.

13.zh: 他胞兄押沙龙问他说：莫非你哥哥暗嫩与你亲近了么？我妹妹，暂且不要作声，他是你的哥哥，不要将这事放在心上。他玛就孤孤单单地住在他胞兄押沙龙家里。
13.en: Her brother Absalom said to her, "Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet now, my sister; he is your brother. Don't take this thing to heart." And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom's house, a desolate woman.

13.zh: 大卫王听见这事，就甚发怒。
13.en: When King David heard all this, he was furious.

13.zh: 押沙龙并不和他哥哥暗嫩说好说歹；因为暗嫩玷辱他妹妹他玛，所以押沙龙恨恶他。
13.en: Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.

13.zh: 过了二年，在靠近以法莲的巴力夏琐有人为押沙龙剪羊毛；押沙龙请王的众子与他同去。
13.en: Two years later, when Absalom's sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king's sons to come there.

13.zh: 押沙龙来见王，说：现在有人为仆人剪羊毛，请王和王的臣仆与仆人同去。
13.en: Absalom went to the king and said, "Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his officials please join me?"

13.zh: 王对押沙龙说：我儿，我们不必都去，恐怕使你耗费太多。押沙龙再三请王，王仍是不肯去，只为他祝福。
13.en: "No, my son," the king replied. "All of us should not go; we would only be a burden to you." Although Absalom urged him, he still refused to go, but gave him his blessing.

13.zh: 押沙龙说：王若不去，求王许我哥哥暗嫩同去。王说：何必要他去呢？
13.en: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us." The king asked him, "Why should he go with you?"

13.zh: 押沙龙再三求王，王就许暗嫩和王的众子与他同去。
13.en: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king's sons.

13.zh: 押沙龙吩咐仆人说：你们注意，看暗嫩饮酒畅快的时候，我对你们说杀暗嫩，你们便杀他，不要惧怕。这不是我吩咐你们的么？你们只管壮胆奋勇！
13.en: Absalom ordered his men, "Listen! When Amnon is in high spirits from drinking wine and I say to you, 'Strike Amnon down,' then kill him. Don't be afraid. Have not I given you this order? Be strong and brave."

13.zh: 押沙龙的仆人就照押沙龙所吩咐的，向暗嫩行了。王的众子都起来，各人骑上骡子，逃跑了。
13.en: So Absalom's men did to Amnon what Absalom had ordered. Then all the king's sons got up, mounted their mules and fled.

13.zh: 他们还在路上，有风声传到大卫那里，说：押沙龙将王的众子都杀了，没有留下一个。
13.en: While they were on their way, the report came to David: "Absalom has struck down all the king's sons; not one of them is left."

13.zh: 王就起来，撕裂衣服，躺在地上。王的臣仆也都撕裂衣服，站在旁边。
13.en: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

13.zh: 大卫的长兄，示米亚的儿子约拿达说：我主，不要以为王的众子 ─ 少年人都杀了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。自从暗嫩玷辱押沙龙妹子他玛的那日，押沙龙就定意杀暗嫩了。
13.en: But Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother, said, "My lord should not think that they killed all the princes; only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom's expressed intention ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

13.zh: 现在，我主我王，不要把这事放在心上，以为王的众子都死了，只有暗嫩一个人死了。
13.en: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king's sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead."

13.zh: 押沙龙逃跑了。守望的少年人举目观看，见有许多人从山坡的路上来。
13.en: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled. Now the man standing watch looked up and saw many people on the road west of him, coming down the side of the hill. The watchman went and told the king, "I see men in the direction of Horonaim, on the side of the hill."

13.zh: 约拿达对王说：看哪，王的众子都来了，果然与你仆人所说的相合。
13.en: Jonadab said to the king, "See, the king's sons are here; it has happened just as your servant said."

13.zh: 话才说完，王的众子都到了，放声大哭。王和臣仆也都哭得甚恸。
13.en: As he finished speaking, the king's sons came in, wailing loudly. The king, too, and all his servants wept very bitterly.

13.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述王亚米忽的儿子达买那里去了。大卫天天为他儿子悲哀。
13.en: Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But King David mourned for his son every day.

13.zh: 押沙龙逃到基述，在那里住了三年。
13.en: After Absalom fled and went to Geshur, he stayed there three years.

13.zh: 暗嫩死了以后，大卫王得了安慰，心里切切想念押沙龙。
13.en: And the spirit of the king longed to go to Absalom, for he was consoled concerning Amnon's death.

14.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押，知道王心里想念押沙龙，
14.en: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that theking's heart longed for Absalom.

14.zh: 就打发人往提哥亚去，从那里叫了一个聪明的妇人来，对他说：请你假装居丧的，穿上孝衣，不要用膏抹身，要装作为死者许久悲哀的妇人；
14.en: So Joab sent someone to Tekoa and had a wise woman brought from there. He said to her, "Pretend you are in mourning. Dress in mourning clothes, and don't use any cosmetic lotions. Act like a woman who has spent many days grieving for the dead.

14.zh: 进去见王，对王如此如此说。于是约押将当说的话教导了妇人。
14.en: Then go to the king and speak these words to him." And Joab put the words in her mouth.

14.zh: 提哥亚妇人到王面前，伏地叩拜，说：王啊，求你拯救！
14.en: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell with her face to the ground to pay him honor, and she said, "Help me, O king!"

14.zh: 王问他说：你有甚么事呢？回答说：婢女实在是寡妇，我丈夫死了。
14.en: The king asked her, "What is troubling you?" She said, "I am indeed a widow; my husband is dead.

14.zh: 我有两个儿子，一日在田间争斗，没有人解劝，这个就打死那个。
14.en: I your servant had two sons. They got into a fight with each other in the field, and no one was there to separate them. One struck the other and killed him.

14.zh: 现在全家的人都起来攻击婢女，说：你将那打死兄弟的交出来，我们好治死他，偿他打死兄弟的命，灭绝那承受家业的。这样，他们要将我剩下的炭火灭尽，不与我丈夫留名留后在世上。
14.en: Now the whole clan has risen up against your servant; they say, 'Hand over the one who struck his brother down, so that we may put him to death for the life of his brother whom he killed; then we will get rid of the heir as well.' They would put out the only burning coal I have left, leaving my husband neither name nor descendant on the face of the earth."

14.zh: 王对妇人说：你回家去罢！我必为你下令。
14.en: The king said to the woman, "Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf."

14.zh: 提哥亚妇人又对王说：我主我王，愿这罪归我和我父家，与王和王的位无干。
14.en: But the woman from Tekoa said to him, "My lord the king, let the blame rest on me and on my father's family, and let the king and his throne be without guilt."

14.zh: 王说：凡难为你的，你就带他到我这里来，他必不再搅扰你。
14.en: The king replied, "If anyone says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you again."

14.zh: 妇人说：愿王记念耶和华 ─ 你的神，不许报血仇的人施行灭绝，恐怕他们灭绝我的儿子。王说：我指著永生的耶和华起誓：你的儿子连一根头发也不致落在地上。
14.en: She said, "Then let the king invoke the Lord his God to prevent the avenger of blood from adding to the destruction, so that my son will not be destroyed." "As surely as the Lord lives," he said, "not one hair of your son's head will fall to the ground."

14.zh: 妇人说：求我主我王容婢女再说一句话。王说：你说罢！
14.en: Then the woman said, "Let your servant speak a word to my lord the king." "Speak," he replied.

14.zh: 妇人说：王为何也起意要害神的民呢？王不使那逃亡的人回来，王的这话就是自证己错了！
14.en: The woman said, "Why then have you devised a thing like this against the people of God? When the king says this, does he not convict himself, for the king has not brought back his banished son?

14.zh: 我们都是必死的，如同水泼在地上，不能收回。神并不夺取人的性命，乃设法使逃亡的人不致成为赶出 、 回不来的。
14.en: Like water spilled on the ground, which cannot be recovered, so we must die. But God does not take away life; instead, he devises ways so that a banished person may not remain estranged from him.

14.zh: 我来将这话告诉我主我王，是因百姓使我惧怕。婢女想，不如将这话告诉王，或者王成就婢女所求的。
14.en: "And now I have come to say this to my lord the king because the people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, 'I will speak to the king; perhaps he will do what his servant asks.

14.zh: 人要将我和我儿子从神的地业上一同除灭，王必应允救我脱离他的手。
14.en: Perhaps the king will agree to deliver his servant from the hand of the man who is trying to cut off both me and my son from the inheritance God gave us.'

14.zh: 婢女又想，我主我王的话必安慰我；因为我主我王能辨别是非，如同神的使者一样。惟愿耶和华 ─ 你的神与你同在！
14.en: "And now your servant says, 'May the word of my lord the king bring me rest, for my lord the king is like an angel of God in discerning good and evil. May the Lord your God be with you.' "

14.zh: 王对妇人说：我要问你一句话，你一点不要瞒我。妇人说：愿我主我王说。
14.en: Then the king said to the woman, "Do not keep from me the answer to what I am going to ask you." "Let my lord the king speak," the woman said.

14.zh: 王说：你这些话莫非是约押的主意么？妇人说：我敢在我主我王面前起誓：王的话正对，不偏左右，是王的仆人约押吩咐我的，这些话是他教导我的。
14.en: The king asked, "Isn't the hand of Joab with you in all this?" The woman answered, "As surely as you live, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right or to the left from anything my lord the king says. Yes, it was your servant Joab who instructed me to do this and who put all these words into the mouth of your servant.

14.zh: 王的仆人约押如此行，为要挽回这事。我主的智慧却如神使者的智慧，能知世上一切事。
14.en: Your servant Joab did this to change the present situation. My lord has wisdom like that of an angel of God-he knows everything that happens in the land."

14.zh: 王对约押说：我应允你这事。你可以去，把那少年人押沙龙带回来。
14.en: The king said to Joab, "Very well, I will do it. Go, bring back the young man Absalom."

14.zh: 约押就面伏于地叩拜，祝谢于王，又说：王既应允仆人所求的，仆人今日知道在我主我王眼前蒙恩了。
14.en: Joab fell with his face to the ground to pay him honor, and he blessed the king. Joab said, "Today your servant knows that he has found favor in your eyes, my lord the king, because the king has granted his servant's request."

14.zh: 于是约押起身往基述去，将押沙龙带回耶路撒冷。
14.en: Then Joab went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

14.zh: 王说：使他回自己家里去，不要见我的面。押沙龙就回自己家里去，没有见王的面。
14.en: But the king said, "He must go to his own house; he must not see my face." So Absalom went to his own house and did not see the face of the king.

14.zh: 以色列全地之中，无人像押沙龙那样俊美，得人的称赞，从脚底到头顶毫无暇疵。
14.en: In all Israel there was not a man so highly praised for his handsome appearance as Absalom. From the top of his head to the sole of his foot there was no blemish in him.

14.zh: 他的头发甚重，每到年底剪发一次；所剪下来的，按王的平称一称，重二百舍客勒。
14.en: Whenever he cut the hair of his head-he used to cut his hair from time to time when it became too heavy for him-he would weigh it, and its weight was two hundred shekels by the royal standard.

14.zh: 押沙龙生了三个儿子，一个女儿。女儿名叫他玛，是个容貌俊美的女子。
14.en: Three sons and a daughter were born to Absalom. The daughter's name was Tamar, and she became a beautiful woman.

14.zh: 押沙龙住在耶路撒冷足有二年，没有见王的面。
14.en: Absalom lived two years in Jerusalem without seeing the king's face.

14.zh: 押沙龙打发人去叫约押来，要托他去见王，约押却不肯来。第二次打发人去叫他，他仍不肯来。
14.en: Then Absalom sent for Joab in order to send him to the king, but Joab refused to come to him. So he sent a second time, but he refused to come.

14.zh: 所以押沙龙对仆人说：你们看，约押有一块田，与我的田相近，其中有大麦，你们去放火烧了。押沙龙的仆人就去放火烧了那田。
14.en: Then he said to his servants, "Look, Joab's field is next to mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire." So Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

14.zh: 于是约押起来，到了押沙龙家里，问他说：你的仆人为何放火烧了我的田呢？
14.en: Then Joab did go to Absalom's house and he said to him, "Why have your servants set my field on fire?"

14.zh: 押沙龙回答约押说：我打发人去请你来，好托你去见王，替我说：我为何从基述回来呢？不如仍在那里。现在要许我见王的面；我若有罪，任凭王杀我就是了。
14.en: Absalom said to Joab, "Look, I sent word to you and said, 'Come here so I can send you to the king to ask, "Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me if I were still there!" ' Now then, I want to see the king's face, and if I am guilty of anything, let him put me to death."

14.zh: 于是约押去见王，将这话奏告王，王便叫押沙龙来。押沙龙来见王，在王面前俯伏于地，王就与押沙龙亲嘴。
14.en: So Joab went to the king and told him this. Then the king summoned Absalom, and he came in and bowed down with his face to the ground before the king. And the king kissed Absalom.

15.zh: 此后，押沙龙为自己预备车马，又派五十人在他前头奔走。
15.en: In the course of time, Absalom provided himself with a chariot and horses and with fifty men to run ahead of him.

15.zh: 押沙龙常常早晨起来，站在城门的道旁，凡有争讼要去求王判断的，押沙龙就叫他过来，问他说：你是哪一城的人？回答说：仆人是以色列某支派的人。
15.en: He would get up early and stand by the side of the road leading to the city gate. Whenever anyone came with a complaint to be placed before the king for a decision, Absalom would call out to him, "What town are you from?" He would answer, "Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel."

15.zh: 押沙龙对他说：你的事有情有理，无奈王没有委人听你伸诉。
15.en: Then Absalom would say to him, "Look, your claims are valid and proper, but there is no representative of the king to hear you."

15.zh: 押沙龙又说：恨不得我作国中的士师！凡有争讼求审判的到我这里来，我必秉公判断。
15.en: And Absalom would add, "If only I were appointed judge in the land! Then everyone who has a complaint or case could come to me and I would see that he gets justice."

15.zh: 若有人近前来要拜押沙龙，押沙龙就伸手拉住他，与他亲嘴。
15.en: Also, whenever anyone approached him to bow down before him, Absalom would reach out his hand, take hold of him and kiss him.

15.zh: 以色列人中，凡去见王求判断的，押沙龙都是如此待他们。这样，押沙龙暗中得了以色列人的心。
15.en: Absalom behaved in this way toward all the Israelites who came to the king asking for justice, and so he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

15.zh: 满了四十年（有作四年的），押沙龙对王说：求你准我往希伯仑去，还我向耶和华所许的愿。
15.en: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, "Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow I made to the Lord .

15.zh: 因为仆人住在亚兰的基述，曾许愿说：耶和华若使我再回耶路撒冷，我必事奉他。
15.en: While your servant was living at Geshur in Aram, I made this vow: 'If the Lord takes me back to Jerusalem, I will worship the Lord in Hebron. ' "

15.zh: 王说：你平平安安地去罢！押沙龙就起身，往希伯仑去了。
15.en: The king said to him, "Go in peace." So he went to Hebron.

15.zh: 押沙龙打发探子走遍以色列各支派，说：你们一听见角声就说：押沙龙在希伯仑作王了！
15.en: Then Absalom sent secret messengers throughout the tribes of Israel to say, "As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpets, then say, 'Absalom is king in Hebron.' "

15.zh: 押沙龙在耶路撒冷请了二百人与他同去，都是诚诚实实去的，并不知道其中的真情。
15.en: Two hundred men from Jerusalem had accompanied Absalom. They had been invited as guests and went quite innocently, knowing nothing about the matter.

15.zh: 押沙龙献祭的时候，打发人去将大卫的谋士 、 基罗人亚希多弗从他本城请了来。于是叛逆的势派甚大；因为随从押沙龙的人民，日渐增多。
15.en: While Absalom was offering sacrifices, he also sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counselor, to come from Giloh, his hometown. And so the conspiracy gained strength, and Absalom's following kept on increasing.

15.zh: 有人报告大卫说：以色列人的心都归向押沙龙了！
15.en: A messenger came and told David, "The hearts of the men of Israel are with Absalom."

15.zh: 大卫就对耶路撒冷跟随他的臣仆说：我们要起来逃走，不然都不能躲避押沙龙了；要速速地去，恐怕他忽然来到，加害于我们，用刀杀尽合城的人。
15.en: Then David said to all his officials who were with him in Jerusalem, "Come! We must flee, or none of us will escape from Absalom. We must leave immediately, or he will move quickly to overtake us and bring ruin upon us and put the city to the sword."

15.zh: 王的臣仆对王说：我主我王所定的，仆人都愿遵行。
15.en: The king's officials answered him, "Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king chooses."

15.zh: 于是王带著全家的人出去了，但留下十个妃嫔看守宫殿。
15.en: The king set out, with his entire household following him; but he left ten concubines to take care of the palace.

15.zh: 王出去，众民都跟随他，到伯墨哈，就住下了。
15.en: So the king set out, with all the people following him, and they halted at a place some distance away.

15.zh: 王的臣仆都在他面前过去。基利提人 、 比利提人，就是从迦特跟随王来的六百人，也都在他面前过去。
15.en: All his men marched past him, along with all the Kerethites and Pelethites; and all the six hundred Gittites who had accompanied him from Gath marched before the king.

15.zh: 王对迦特人以太说：你是外邦逃来的人，为甚么与我们同去呢？你可以回去与新王同住，或者回你本地去罢！
15.en: The king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why should you come along with us? Go back and stay with King Absalom. You are a foreigner, an exile from your homeland.

15.zh: 你来的日子不多，我今日怎好叫你与我们一同飘流 、 没有一定的住处呢？你不如带你的弟兄回去罢！愿耶和华用慈爱诚实待你。
15.en: You came only yesterday. And today shall I make you wander about with us, when I do not know where I am going? Go back, and take your countrymen. May kindness and faithfulness be with you."

15.zh: 以太对王说：我指著永生的耶和华起誓，又敢在王面前起誓：无论生死，王在哪里，仆人也必在那里。
15.en: But Ittai replied to the king, "As surely as the Lord lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether it means life or death, there will your servant be."

15.zh: 大卫对以太说：你前去过河罢！于是迦特人以太带著跟随他的人和所有的妇人孩子，就都过去了。
15.en: David said to Ittai, "Go ahead, march on." So Ittai the Gittite marched on with all his men and the families that were with him.

15.zh: 本地的人都放声大哭。众民尽都过去，王也过了汲沦溪；众民往旷野去了。
15.en: The whole countryside wept aloud as all the people passed by. The king also crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the people moved on toward the desert.

15.zh: 撒督和抬神约柜的利未人也一同来了，将神的约柜放下。亚比亚他上来，等著众民从城里出来过去。
15.en: Zadok was there, too, and all the Levites who were with him were carrying the ark of the covenant of God. They set down the ark of God, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until all the people had finished leaving the city.

15.zh: 王对撒督说：你将神的约柜抬回城去。我若在耶和华眼前蒙恩，他必使我回来，再见约柜和他的居所。
15.en: Then the king said to Zadok, "Take the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the Lord 's eyes, he will bring me back and let me see it and his dwelling place again.

15.zh: 倘若他说：我不喜悦你，看哪，我在这里，愿他凭自己的意旨待我！
15.en: But if he says, 'I am not pleased with you,' then I am ready; let him do to me whatever seems good to him."

15.zh: 王又对祭司撒督说：你不是先见么？你可以安然回城；你儿子亚希玛斯和亚比亚他的儿子约拿单都可以与你同去。
15.en: The king also said to Zadok the priest, "Aren't you a seer? Go back to the city in peace, with your son Ahimaaz and Jonathan son of Abiathar. You and Abiathar take your two sons with you.

15.zh: 我在旷野的渡口那里等你们报信给我。
15.en: I will wait at the fords in the desert until word comes from you to inform me."

15.zh: 于是撒督和亚比亚他将神的约柜抬回耶路撒冷，他们就住在那里。
15.en: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem and stayed there.

15.zh: 大卫蒙头赤脚上橄榄山，一面上一面哭。跟随他的人也都蒙头哭著上去；
15.en: But David continued up the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went; his head was covered and he was barefoot. All the people with him covered their heads too and were weeping as they went up.

15.zh: 有人告诉大卫说：亚希多弗也在叛党之中，随从押沙龙。大卫祷告说：耶和华啊，求你使亚希多弗的计谋变为愚拙！
15.en: Now David had been told, "Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom." So David prayed, "O Lord , turn Ahithophel's counsel into foolishness."

15.zh: 大卫到了山顶 、 敬拜神的地方，见亚基人户筛，衣服撕裂，头蒙灰尘来迎接他。
15.en: When David arrived at the summit, where people used to worship God, Hushai the Arkite was there to meet him, his robe torn and dust on his head.

15.zh: 大卫对他说：你若与我同去，必累赘我；
15.en: David said to him, "If you go with me, you will be a burden to me.

15.zh: 你若回城去，对押沙龙说：王啊，我愿作你的仆人；我向来作你父亲的仆人，现在我也照样作你的仆人。这样，你就可以为我破坏亚希多弗的计谋。
15.en: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, 'I will be your servant, O king; I was your father's servant in the past, but now I will be your servant,' then you can help me by frustrating Ahithophel's advice.

15.zh: 祭司撒督和亚比亚他岂不都在那里么？你在王宫里听见甚么，就要告诉祭司撒督和亚比亚他。
15.en: Won't the priests Zadok and Abiathar be there with you? Tell them anything you hear in the king's palace.

15.zh: 撒督的儿子亚希玛斯，亚比亚他的儿子约拿单，也都在那里。凡你们所听见的可以托这二人来报告我。
15.en: Their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with anything you hear."

15.zh: 于是，大卫的朋友户筛进了城；押沙龙也进了耶路撒冷。
15.en: So David's friend Hushai arrived at Jerusalem as Absalom was entering the city.

16.zh: 大卫刚过山顶，见米非波设的仆人洗巴拉著备好了的两匹驴，驴上驮著二百面饼，一百葡萄饼，一百个夏天的果饼，一皮袋酒来迎接他。
16.en: When David had gone a short distance beyond the summit, there was Ziba, the steward of Mephibosheth, waiting to meet him. He had a string of donkeys saddled and loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred cakes of raisins, a hundred cakes of figs and a skin of wine.

16.zh: 王问洗巴说：你带这些来是甚么意思呢？洗巴说：驴是给王的家眷骑的；面饼和夏天的果饼是给少年人吃的；酒是给在旷野疲乏人喝的。
